Name: PomPomeroy's Small Dog Bark Replacement
Author: PomPomeroy
Description:
I've always had a small dog instead of the large vanilla dogs, so I decided to swap out the deep vanilla bark for some small yaps!
This mod features sound files recorded by playing with my Pomeranian. 


Installation:
~ Install Custom Music.
~ Download this mod and extract it to the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley directory.
~ Enjoy the sweet sound of tiny barks!

**I do not own the pictured pixel dog. I got it [url=http://pixelartmaker.com/art/e5cbab002710d69]here.[/url]﻿**
